bioAdditions:
Elizabeth A. 'Betsy' McGuire was born in Wilkes-Barre on 8 March 1928, the identical twin of Ann 'Nancy' McGuire, daughters of Francis McGuire and Elizabeth McAvoy (S1, S2). She graduated from Elmer L. Meyers High School in 1945 and on 13 September 1952 married Harold E. Arnold in Wilkes-Barre (S1). The couple settled in the Altoona area; Harold died on 27 May 1997 (S1, S4). Her widowed mother also died in Altoona in 1984, probably while living near Betsy.

Betsy died at UPMC Altoona on Tuesday 8 November 2016, aged 88, a member of St. Joseph Catholic Church in Bellwood. She was survived by a son and two daughters, six grandchildren and three great-grandchildren, and predeceased by her sisters Jane Nagle, her twin Nancy Holland and 'Kay Meier' (John's grandmother Kathryn). She was buried from St. Joseph's, Bellwood, with committal at Calvary Cemetery, Altoona (S1). She is therefore NOT living; the site's 'presumed_living' status should change.
funFacts: She and her sister Nancy were identical twins (S2), confirming the site's 'possibly twin of Ann' note.

conflicts.assessment: Obituary is decisive. FamilySearch's 'november 8 1916' is a typo for 2016.

conflicts.siteValue: Site says the widow Elizabeth (McAvoy) McGuire remarried Harold Arnold
conflicts.foundValue: Harold E. Arnold (b. 6 Jul 1927) married the DAUGHTER Betsy on 13 Sep 1952
conflicts.assessment: The 'remarried Harold Arnold' statement on I282604493938 and I282604493482 comes from a FamilySearch duplicate profile (GP7C-XR4) wrongly attached to the mother. Harold was 30 years her junior and is named as Betsy's husband in Betsy's obituary. Recommend removing the remarriage from the mother's record.
